title: Fomo Kernel Question Episode
description: One replayable evaluation asset: a state fixture, the question a user asked against it, and graded candidate answers. The unit is one question answered, not one review session (#417). Every episode is synthetic or privacy-lint-cleared failure structure; real trade data never enters this directory.

id.description: Stable slug, also the filename stem. Conventionally starts with the originating issue number.

title.description: What this episode holds the product to, in one line.

source.description: Where the miss came from. Provenance is the point: an episode with no traceable origin is a rule someone invented.

kind.description: `real_use_miss` requires the text to have passed tools/privacy_lint.py before it was written down; only failure structure survives de-identification.

language.description: The locale the answer was delivered in. `language_purity` reads it.

question.description: The question as the user met it.

fixture.description: Engine artifacts the answer had to stay faithful to. Any subset of a session bundle; `grounded_numbers` recomputes every figure in an answer against this object and nothing else.

required_mentions.description: Facts the answer must carry. Each entry passes when any one of its phrases appears; the list form exists so a locale or a wording change does not invalidate the episode.

forbidden_mentions.description: Phrases the answer must not carry — the recorded miss's own words, usually.

candidates.description: At least one recorded miss and at least one answer that should pass. A validator that never fires on the miss, or that fires on the corrected answer, is not evidence — the two candidates are what keep the check honest.

expect_findings.description: Validator names that must fire, exactly. Required when expect is `fail`: asserting only that something failed lets an unrelated regression keep the episode green.

rubric.description: The judge half (#417 stage 2). Recorded now, executed by nothing today — the offline runner ignores it rather than pretending prose quality is mechanically decidable.
